name: A victory with a danger left

date.label: The Burning Crusade · after the raid battle

summary: Kil’jaeden is gone, yet corruption still clouds the Sunwell. Regent Lord Lor’themar considers destroying it lest the sickness spread beyond the fount. A victory has spared Quel’Thalas from one catastrophe, but the price may yet be the heart of the kingdom. Then Velen comes to honor M’uru.
